summary: Armed orch-stop.sh in LIVE workspace settings.json (PreToolUse matcher "*", ahead of the Write|Edit->orch-gate entry), closing the sample-vs-live gap from #17. Verified: JSON valid; wired before edit-gate; orch-stop.sh exits 0 for a no-flag session (no self-lockout). Cooperative-stop enforcement is now LIVE: a worker whose claimed task has cancel_requested OR whose agent has stop_requested gets exit-2 STOP on its next tool call. Edit itself dogfooded the gate (claimed #18 first so the edit passed). Positive exit-2 path not re-tested on the live session to avoid self-lockout — covered by smoke 38/38 (synthetic flagged-session -> exit 2). Follow-on remains: self-scheduling loop #12 must poll /should-stop itself (PreToolUse can't interrupt an in-process loop).
